provenance: Development-only comparison using authored synthetic scenarios. Rules were improved using these scenarios; this is not independent validation.
baselineScope: Backend assessment after commercial-spam label correction, before the new warning-context corrections and model replacement.
limitations: Training labels and splits changed, so previous model-file scores are not a controlled before/after comparison.
The text model alone still flags 7 of 18 legitimate challenge messages; its advisory output must not be treated as a fraud verdict.
The URL model catches about 58% of source-labeled phishing samples in this grouped test.
Independent human-reviewed examples, source/time holdouts, and image/OCR benchmarks remain necessary.
